context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 113 tested field-visibility endpoint and MATCH+UPDATE validation. Key findings: (1) field-visibility endpoint at /api/business-tools/panels/{panel_id}/field-visibility returns merged visibility from all active automation rules targeting the panel. (3) update_record action requires all 5 fields: match_target_field, match_source_field, update_field, update_operation, update_value_from. (4) Preview endpoint returns structured MATCH + UPDATE sections for update_record actions. (5) E2E tests confirm MATCH+UPDATE engine works: relation fields store ObjectIds, matching by ID works, edge cases (null/empty values) handled correctly.
